requirements.description: A host Ruby toolchain at the pinned version 3.4.2 that runs plain `ruby` in non-interactive shells (shims on PATH), so bin/setup and the Rails toolchain work.

The Gemfile/Gemfile.lock dependency set is installed into the persistent bundle at {cache}/bundle and `bundle check` succeeds both from the repository and from the cache root with the vendored Gemfile (BUNDLE_GEMFILE), per the environment bootstrap contract.
A PostgreSQL 17 server with the pgvector 'vector' extension reachable at 127.0.0.1:5432 (trust auth, user postgres) so migrations and schema load can apply.

A Docker engine with the compose plugin must be running so the documented dev, QA and smoke compose stacks can be orchestrated. Required base images (pgvector pg17, ruby:3.4.2, node:22-bookworm-slim, the pinned mailpit digest, and clamav/clamav:latest used by the CI virus scan) are pre-pulled during install into the cache-backed Docker data-root ({cache}/docker/data) and asserted by check-docker-images. The project images (Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml and compose.qa.yaml builds) are pre-built during install by install-build-images into the same persisted layer cache and platform:build is asserted by check-prebuilt-images, so clean-verification builds and compose boots are layer-cached and offline-capable.

Node.js 22 and npm must be usable for the frontend asset operations (npm ci, build:css, build:flow_canvas), with the npm dependency set pre-provisioned offline via the persisted npm cache and node_modules in {cache}.
The helm CLI must be available so `helm lint chart --strict` can run against the repository chart.
gh, jq and git executables must be present on PATH as required by the repository's skill scripts.
A repo.env file at the repository root, created from repo.env.example, must exist with the required VIVI_* keys (VIVI_REPO, VIVI_DEFAULT_BRANCH) for the skill scripts.

Offline npm provisioning: the npm download cache ({cache}/npm-cache) and a persisted node_modules tree ({cache}/node_modules) must exist so npm ci / asset builds can run without network during clean verification.
